# Worth - Free Money Calculators (Open Source on GitHub)
> 46 free calculators and guides. Private, browser-only, no sign-up. MIT licensed on GitHub.

## What is Worth?
Worth converts money to time. How many work hours does a purchase cost? Free calculators for salary to hourly, freelance rate, cost per wear, latte factor, overtime, subscription audit. Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/njohn931d-dotcom/bbbh

## Calculators (18)
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/cost-of-time/ - Cost of Time Calculator - Find how many work hours a purchase costs using your after-tax hourly, monthly, or annual pay. Free calculator with the formula and worked examples.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/subscription-cost/ - Subscription Cost Calculator - Convert monthly subscription fees into annual costs and hours of work. See the real cost of streaming, apps, and memberships with a free calculator.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/daily-savings/ - Daily Savings Calculator - See how saving $1, $5, or $10 a day adds up over a year. Calculate simple daily savings without assumed investment returns or interest.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/salary-to-hourly/ - Salary to Hourly Calculator - Convert annual salary to hourly rate instantly. Formula: salary ÷ 2080. Free, open-source calculator with overtime and after-tax adjustments. GitHub source.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/hourly-to-salary/ - Hourly to Salary Calculator - Convert hourly wage to annual salary: hourly × 2080. Free calculator shows monthly, weekly, after-tax. Open source on GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/freelance-rate/ - Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator - Freelance rate calculator: (salary + expenses + profit) ÷ billable hours. Includes taxes, benefits, PTO. Free, open source on GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/cost-per-wear/ - Cost Per Wear Calculator - Cost per wear = price ÷ wears. Calculate true clothing value. $200 jacket worn 100 times = $2/wear. Free open source calculator.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/cost-per-use/ - Cost Per Use Calculator - Cost per use = price ÷ uses. Calculate true value of gadgets, tools, memberships. Free calculator, open source on GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/overtime-pay/ - Overtime Pay Calculator - Calculate overtime pay: time and a half = 1.5× hourly. Double time = 2×. Free calculator with weekly, biweekly. Open source.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/after-tax-income/ - After Tax Income Calculator - Calculate take-home pay after federal, state, FICA. Enter gross salary, get net hourly, monthly. Free, open source GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/commute-cost/ - Cost of Commuting Calculator - Commute cost calculator: gas + time + wear + lost wages. 1 hour commute = $12,500/year in time alone. Free, GitHub open source.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/latte-factor/ - Latte Factor Calculator - Latte factor calculator: daily $5 habit = $1,825/year. See 10, 30 year total. Free calculator, open source on GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/gym-cost-per-visit/ - Gym Cost Per Visit Calculator - Gym cost per visit = monthly fee ÷ visits. $50/month ÷ 4 visits = $12.50/visit. Free calculator, open source GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/streaming-cost/ - Streaming Cost Calculator - Streaming calculator: Netflix + Spotify + Hulu annual cost and hours worked. Average American $1,200/yr. Free GitHub open source.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/car-ownership-cost/ - True Cost of Car Ownership Calculator - True car cost calculator: payment + gas + insurance + maintenance ÷ hours driven. Average $0.70/mile. Free, open source GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/time-to-save/ - How Long to Save Calculator - How long to save $1000? Enter daily saving, hourly rate. See days, work hours needed. Free calculator GitHub open source.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/paycheck-breakdown/ - Paycheck Breakdown Calculator - Paycheck breakdown: rent = 12 hours, groceries = 4 hours. See where work hours go. Free calculator, open source GitHub.
- https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh/calculators/buy-vs-rent-hourly/ - Buy vs Rent Hourly Calculator - Buy vs rent calculator: mortgage + maintenance vs rent, cost per hour lived. Free, open source on GitHub.
